up: Retrieve the distinct compound identifiers (CHEMBL IDs) and any available compound names from the specified document CHEMBL5727864. Ensure to join activities with docs to restrict to the correct doc_id and to compound_records to keep provenance of compound keys when provided. Return each compound once only.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name
FROM activities a
LEFT JOIN assay ON a.assay_id = assay.assay_id
LEFT JOIN target_dictionary ON assay.tid = target_dictionary.tid
LEFT JOIN docs ON a.doc_id = docs.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727864' AND cr.molregno = a.molregno
ORDER BY cr.compound_name;

up: Retrieve the distinct compound identifiers (CHEMBL IDs) and any available compound names from the specified document CHEMBL5727864. Ensure to join activities with docs to restrict to the correct doc_id and to compound_records to keep provenance of compound keys when provided. Return each compound once only.
sql:
WITH act AS (SELECT a.activity_id, a.molecule_chembl_id, a.molregno, a.doc_id, a.record_id
    FROM activities a WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727864')),
md AS (SELECT md.molregno, md.pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary md),
cr AS (SELECT cr.molregno, cr.compound_name
    FROM compound_records cr)
SELECT DISTINCT act.molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cr.compound_name
FROM act
JOIN md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno
ORDER BY cr.compound_name;

up: Retrieve all distinct molecules (CHEMBL IDs and corresponding compound names) that are reported in document CHEMBL5727864. The query must return one row per molecule regardless of how many activities it has in the document. Use the activities table filtered by document, join to molecule_dictionary to get the public CHEMBL identifier and preferred name, and join to compound_records to retrieve any compound_key or compound_name fields when available. Preserve DISTINCT on the combination of molecule CHEMBL ID and compound name to avoid duplicate rows caused by multiple activity records for the same molecule.
sql:
WITH act AS (SELECT a.activity_id, a.molregno, a.doc_id, a.record_id
    FROM activities a WHERE a.doc_id = (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727864'))
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name
FROM act
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON act.molregno = cr.molregno
ORDER BY cr.compound_name;
